task: focused revision of 3 residual UI bugs (fraction/blank numerics, fp16 badge honesty, copy-failure status)
environment: docker exec zexkora-growth-sandbox (repo bind-mounted at /workspace); no host GUI, no paid models

bugs_fixed.symptom: c=1.5 became context 1 and b=2.5 became batch 2 with notices hidden; blank field silently became the default
bugs_fixed.root_cause: web/app.js readControls() ran parseInt on the field values and onChange() replaced NaN with 8192/1 before state.parseState() (the strict parser) ever saw the raw text
fix: readControls() now passes the raw context/batch strings; onChange() forwards them unchanged so state.parseWhole() rejects '1.5'/'2.5' with a visible notice and falls back to the documented defaults
blank *entered field* now raises an explicit field-level notice in onChange ('... was left blank; using the default N ...')
the URL contract is preserved: a blank c=/b= parameter is still a silent documented default (no notice), as asserted by the pre-existing node test

bugs_fixed.symptom: FP16 showed badge 'exact official file' although weights source is official_safetensors_size_equivalent
bugs_fixed.root_cause: web/app.js render() hardcoded the exact-file label for every quantisation
fix: badge is now 'size equivalent' (class badge est) for official_safetensors_size_equivalent and 'exact official file' (badge exact) for official_gguf / official bf16
new always-visible provenance line #prov-weights-basis explains the bf16 basis: 2 bytes per element, the byte total is the official BF16 size, there is no separate FP16 file at this revision
badge title carries the same basis plus the pinned revision

bugs_fixed.symptom: status said 'Report copied to clipboard.' when navigator.clipboard.writeText rejected and document.execCommand() returned false
bugs_fixed.root_cause: the legacy fallback called document.execCommand('copy') and then done() unconditionally, ignoring the returned boolean
fix: success is announced only when writeText resolves or document.execCommand('copy') === true
both paths failing shows 'Copy failed: the browser refused clipboard access...' and reveals a visible readonly textarea prefilled with the real report text, focused and fully selected
the success path hides and clears the manual-copy box; the hidden scratch textarea used for execCommand is still removed

tests_added: tests/node/state.test.cjs: 'fractional context/batch are rejected instead of silently truncated'

copy_failure_simulation.method: page.add_init_script with an IIFE (a bare arrow function string is never invoked by add_init_script - that was the earlier ineffective-injection bug)
copy_failure_simulation.stub: Object.defineProperty on both navigator and Navigator.prototype for clipboard + document.execCommand override
copy_failure_simulation.self_check: _assert_copy_simulation() probes window.__copyStubInstalled, typeof navigator.clipboard.writeText, document.execCommand('copy') === expected and navigator.clipboard.writeText('probe') -> 'rejected' before clicking
copy_failure_simulation.normal_path_untouched: the pre-existing real-OS-clipboard tests (read_clipboard comparison) still run without any stub in both browsers and pass
